metadata.question: Was the cone of Mount Vesuvius, located 12 kilometers southeast of Naples, Italy, visible with Landsat 8 on January 2, 2022?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: Landsat 8 (LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2 or T1_TOA) - Date: January 2, 2022 - Location: Mount Vesuvius, ~12km SE of Naples, Italy (approximately 40.82°N, 14.43°E) 2. Masking strategy: - The question asks if the cone was "visible", which means we need to check if clouds obscured it - Should NOT mask clouds - we need to determine if clouds were present over the volcano - Check cloud cover percentage or visual band values 3. Logic: - If no images exist: C1 - If images exist but heavily clouded over Vesuvius: B (not visible) - If images exist with clear view: A (visible) - Use QA bands or cloud percentage to determine visibility ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Mount Vesuvius location (approximately 40.82°N, 14.43°E) const vesuvius = ee.Geometry.Point([14.4266, 40.8214]); const roi = vesuvius.buffer(2000); // 2km buffer around summit // Date range for January 2, 2022 const startDate = '2022-01-02'; const endDate = '2022-01-03'; // Landsat 8 Collection 2 Level 2 let collection = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(vesuvius) .filterDate(startDate, endDate); const colSize = await collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Landsat 8 images found: ${colSize}`); if (colSize === 0) { // Try expanding date range slightly collection = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(vesuvius) .filterDate('2022-01-01', '2022-01-04'); const colSize2 = await collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Expanded search (Jan 1-3): ${colSize2} images`); if (colSize2 === 0) { console.log('No Landsat 8 images available for this date/location.'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // Get the image const image = collection.first(); // Check cloud cover using QA_PIXEL band const qaPixel = image.select('QA_PIXEL'); // Bit 3 is cloud, bit 4 is cloud shadow const cloudBit = 1 << 3; const cloudShadowBit = 1 << 4; const clouds = qaPixel.bitwiseAnd(cloudBit).neq(0); const cloudShadow = qaPixel.bitwiseAnd(cloudShadowBit).neq(0); const cloudMask = clouds.or(cloudShadow); // Calculate cloud percentage over Vesuvius const stats = await cloudMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: roi, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const cloudPercent = (stats.QA_PIXEL || 0) * 100; console.log(`Cloud coverage over Vesuvius: ${cloudPercent.toFixed(1)}%`); // Also check pixel count const pixelCount = await image.select('SR_B4').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: roi, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); console.log(`Valid pixels: ${pixelCount.SR_B4 || 0}`); if (pixelCount.SR_B4 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels in region.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // If cloud coverage is low (<30%), the cone was visible if (cloudPercent < 30) { console.log('Vesuvius cone was visible (low cloud cover).'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Vesuvius cone was NOT visible (obscured by clouds).'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
